sim:1:Honest relayer forwards the RelayMessage to Ethereum. Bridge verifies signature, marks usedMessageId[42]=true and calls mint on xQUBIT (edge e1).
sim:2:Attacker locks 1 ETH‑equivalent of native BNB on BSC. Bridge emits RelayMessage(msgId=42, amount=1e18, to=Attacker).
sim:3:Compromised relayer re‑sends the same msgId=42 (replay). Due to missing uniqueness check, usedMessageId[42] is still false at entry, allowing a second mint of xQUBIT.
sim:4:State predicate after step 3: usedMessageId[42] == false (should be true) && totalMintedDest == 2 × 1e18, violating the invariant.

sim:4:Upon processing the verified relay, the destination router mints 100 xQUBIT to the attacker, completing the cross‑chain value extraction.
